keyPoints.en: Galileo's telescope (1609–1610): Jupiter's moons; Kepler: elliptical orbits; Newton: gravitation.
keyPoints.bm: Teleskop Galileo (1609–1610): bulan-bulan Musytari; Kepler: orbit elips; Newton: kegravitian.

keyPoints.en: Muslim astronomers (al-Battani, al-Biruni) made precise observations and tables.
keyPoints.bm: Ahli astronomi Islam (al-Battani, al-Biruni) membuat cerapan dan jadual yang tepat.

keyPoints.en: Milestones: Sputnik 1 (1957), Gagarin (1961), Apollo 11 (1969), Hubble (1990), James Webb (2021).
keyPoints.bm: Peristiwa penting: Sputnik 1 (1957), Gagarin (1961), Apollo 11 (1969), Hubble (1990), James Webb (2021).

keyPoints.en: Malaysia: MEASAT, TiungSAT-1 (2000), RazakSAT (2009); Sheikh Muszaphar Shukor to the ISS (2007); MYSA agency.
keyPoints.bm: Malaysia: MEASAT, TiungSAT-1 (2000), RazakSAT (2009); Sheikh Muszaphar Shukor ke ISS (2007); agensi MYSA.

keyPoints.en: Uses: communication, weather, GPS, remote sensing, spin-off inventions. Problem: space debris.
keyPoints.bm: Kegunaan: komunikasi, cuaca, GPS, penderiaan jauh, ciptaan sampingan. Masalah: sampah angkasa.
